response.query: Which topic model and parameters (STM vs. DTM, anchor words) and coherence/stability thresholds (CV, NPMI) should trigger topic re-calibration?
response.answer: Topic re-calibration should trigger when coherence/stability thresholds (CV, NPMI) fall below 0.5 and DTM shows significant drift in anchor words. Use LDA for STM if coherence is low.
